payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Reposition the original blue mug so it is to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The original blue mug is clearly to the right of the headphones in the edited image.
outcome.reference: Identify the blue mug and black over-ear headphones from the source image; compare their horizontal positions in the edited image. Do not count a duplicate or newly introduced mug as the original mug.

check.question: Can the original blue mug and black headphones be identified in the edited image and their relative horizontal positions assessed?
check.complete_when: The original blue mug and headphones are identifiable, visible enough, and their left-to-right positions can be compared confidently.
check.partial_when: One or both objects are only partly visible or their identities or relative positions are ambiguous, but some relevant visual evidence remains.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that the original mug has not been moved toward the right of the headphones.
check.unknown_when: The edited image is unavailable or there is insufficient evidence to identify the original mug or assess its position relative to the headphones.
